positioning: Spain and LatAm's premium ride-hail, on the water
thesis: Balearic island hops and Caribbean resort corridors — the surface no ride-hail platform owns yet.
the_deal: We launch a Cabify-branded foiling water tier across Spain's coastal islands and Colombia's Cartagena archipelago — booked in-app, premium-priced, on registry geometry that already exists.

your_world.text: Land ride-hail is contested in every core city.

your_world.text: Navier adds the water-mobility tier Cabify does not have…

your_world.label: Why now
your_world.text: Foiling lifts the hull clear of the water: faster, dramatically more efficient per passenger-mile…
